### Wire format

Only these types write different bytes than with rc.2:

- A `[NinoType]` struct with `[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]` from another assembly is written member by member
  in every build, as it already was when seen as source. From a package or a command-line build, rc.2 copied it as
  raw memory (#202).

### New

- `[assembly: NinoTypeLayout]` shows the bytes of every value copied as raw memory: its size and each field's offset,
  also inside structs that are not `[NinoType]`s, so changing a field, `Pack`, `Size` or `[FieldOffset]` changes the
  layout (#202). Raw members now read `raw(n){name:type@offset:encoding,...}`, and the members of a raw type are its
  raw encoding. [Layout Metadata](https://nino.xgamedev.net/en/docs/v4/evolving-data#layout-metadata)

### Fixes

- The generator reads `[StructLayout]` and `[FieldOffset]` of structs from another assembly, which Roslyn does not
  show as attributes. A struct with explicit field offsets from a package could be copied as raw memory, whose size
  differs between 64-bit and 32-bit runtimes (#202).

Every change between v4 releases: [Changelog](https://nino.xgamedev.net/en/docs/v4/changelog).
